scope: Independent-clone runner, archive-budget, session-ownership and result-report checks; not a GPU score reproduction claim.
new_coverage: Externally killed controller preserves completed scores and source summary while the watcher exits nonzero.
PID reuse cannot count as a live required service.
An exited agent does not invalidate normal official scoring or handoff.
Terminal summary race is distinguished from interrupted execution.
Finished scores remain verifiable after process cleanup.
Copied runs can be inspected without unrelated local process checks.
